summary_en: Interim dividend raised to 30 ¥/share (from prior forecast 25 ¥), effective 2026-09-15. Full-year dividend forecast raised to 60 ¥/share (from 40 ¥ prior year), with period-end DOE expected at 2.3%. Progressive dividend policy targets DOE 2.5% by FY2028 and 3.0% long-term.
title_en: Notice regarding Interim Dividend (Surplus Distribution) and Full-Year Dividend Forecast Revision (both increases)
translation_en_brief: NIKKISO announced an upward revision to both its interim and full-year dividend forecasts for fiscal year 2026 (ending December 2026) on 14 August 2026. The interim dividend (record date 30 June 2026, payable 15 September 2026) was increased from the prior forecast of 25 yen per share to 30 yen per share, raising the total payout to 1,966 million yen. Concurrently, the full-year dividend forecast was raised from 50 yen per share (25 yen interim + 25 yen final) to 60 yen per share (30 yen interim + 30 yen final), representing a 20-yen increase from the prior fiscal year's actual dividend of 40 yen per share. The revision reflects stronger-than-expected earnings: full-year operating profit guidance was raised by 19.4% and net profit attributable to parent by 21.5%. The company cited its medium-term management plan 'NIKKISO 2028 - Toward a Healthier World' (2026–2028), which targets progressive dividend increases to achieve a dividend-on-equity (DOE) of approximately 2.5% by FY2028 and 3.0% as a long-term target. The expected DOE at FY2026 period-end is approximately 2.3%.
